## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::WithdrawManyEmpty` — the batch withdraw was requested with zero stream ids.

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Pass at least one stream id to `withdraw_many`; an empty batch is rejected.
>
